Description: Per-CELL conformance expectations for Ghent Output Suite patch pages (#1515). Every number a Ghent patch page was previously gated on was an AGGREGATE OVER AREA (page diffFraction/MAE, cell mean RGB, cell luminance/chroma), and the failure these pages announce in their own caption is STRUCTURAL: an X appears inside an otherwise flat cell. A mean absorbs an X in a cell exactly as it absorbs a cell in a page, so no threshold on a mean can see it. Measured on #1514's defect: the Opacity (0%) cell read luminance 109.3 / chroma 160.3 against an oracle consensus of 108.4 / 193.5 -- INSIDE GhentSoftMaskVectorCellTests' own +/-40 and +/-60 tolerances. Hence two measures per cell, not a wider or narrower one.
RectOrigin: Rect is [llx, lly, urx, ury] in PDF points, bottom-left origin -- the fixture's own content-stream coordinates. Read with `mutool trace`, keeping only page-level (transform 1 0 0 -1 0 141.732) 22.676 x 22.678 pt swatch rectangles, NOT back-derived from any excise render. CellInsetPt drops the swatch's own 0.25 pt black `B` stroke frame, whose antialiasing differs per engine and would otherwise dominate the structure measure.

KnownDefectPolicy: A KnownDefect cell is reported by GhentConformanceCellTests as a DECLARED SKIP with its issue in the reason (#1172), never as a pass. It exists so a real, filed, oracle-corroborated defect does not have to be absorbed by widening StructureTolerance -- which would blind the gate to the next one. Delete the entry as each cell is fixed; nothing re-adds it.
